prompt: Grainy egocentric view from a wrist-mounted industrial camera on a FANUC robotic arm, looking down at a pneumatic vacuum suction cup pressing onto the top of a sealed cardboard box on a steel roller conveyor. The camera's wide-angle barrel distortion warps the conveyor edges, and the arm's orange forearm link and black pneumatic hose are visible at the top of the frame. The image has slight motion blur, flat harsh overhead fluorescent lighting, and a timestamp overlay reading 14:32:07 in the lower corner. Scuffed concrete floor and yellow safety bollards are in the peripheral background.

Low-resolution depth-sensor view from a bin-picking robot looking into a grey plastic tote of randomly scattered metal brackets. The arm's magnetic end effector descends from the upper edge of the frame toward a single L-shaped steel bracket. The depth map renders surfaces in a noisy gradient of blues and greens, and the tote's walls and the conveyor's rubber belt are slightly overexposed. A cable conduit and a junction box are mounted on the wall behind, and the sensor's infrared speckle pattern is faintly visible on the bracket surfaces.

Fish-eye egocentric capture from a ceiling-mounted camera above a KUKA palletizing arm, looking down at the arm's flat-plate gripper pressing a single heavy sack of cement powder onto a wooden pallet. The arm's orange joints and the sack's printed label are in focus at the center, and the fish-eye curvature stretches the warehouse floor outward at the edges. Dust hangs in the air, the lighting is uneven with a blown-out strip light on the left, and forklift tire marks streak the grey concrete.

Washed-out egocentric frame from a robotic arm's integrated inspection camera in a bottling plant, looking at a single glass bottle passing under the lens on a high-speed conveyor. The bottle's cap and label are in sharp focus at the center, but the belt vibration creates a subtle horizontal smear on the background bottles. The camera's auto-exposure has overexposed the stainless-steel machinery behind, and a condensation droplet sits on the lens edge, blurring the upper right corner.

Noisy egocentric thermal-camera view from a welding robot's arm, showing the heat signature of a freshly welded seam on a steel chassis rail. The weld bead glows white-hot at the center, fading to orange and purple along the rail. The arm's torch mount is a dark silhouette at the top of the frame, and the fixture clamps and the cold steel of the rail are rendered in deep blues and blacks. The image has the characteristic low resolution and color banding of an industrial FLIR sensor.

Egocentric view from a gripper-mounted GigE industrial camera on a pick-and-place arm in a warehouse, looking down at its parallel-jaw gripper clamping a single white polybag package on a black conveyor belt. The image is sharp but flat, with no depth of field, typical of a fixed-focus machine-vision lens. The gripper's machined aluminium jaws and the arm's wiring loom enter from the top. A barcode scanner's red laser line streaks across the polybag, and the belt's anti-static surface and guide rails fill the sides.

Wide-angle egocentric capture from a mobile robot's front navigation camera as its articulated arm reaches toward a yellow plastic tote on a warehouse shelf. The arm's grey segments and joint motors occupy the lower third of the frame, and the tote's handle and bin label are at the center. The warehouse aisle stretches symmetrically into the distance with floor-level QR navigation markers, and the image has the characteristic slight green tint and noise grain of a low-cost CMOS sensor under artificial LED lighting.

Egocentric still from a sorting robot's overhead line-scan camera, capturing a single dented aluminium can on a moving recycling conveyor. The image is a narrow horizontal strip typical of line-scan acquisition, with the can's crushed surface and printed label stretched slightly by the belt's speed. The arm's pneumatic piston and deflector paddle are visible at the frame's edge, poised to push the can into a chute. The conveyor's black rubber surface and scattered debris are lit by a flat LED bar.

Grainy egocentric view from a robotic arm's wrist camera in a cold-storage meat-processing facility, looking at its hook-style end effector lifting a single vacuum-packed pork loin from a stainless-steel tray. Condensation fogs the camera lens slightly, softening the edges. The meat's vacuum-sealed plastic and the tray's drainage holes are in the center. The room's cold-blue lighting, frosted stainless walls, and the arm's white food-safe housing give the image a sterile, overlit quality. A temperature readout of -2°C is stamped in the corner.

Egocentric depth-camera point cloud rendered as a greyscale image from a bin-picking arm looking into a cardboard box of mixed plastic bottles. The arm's suction cup nozzle enters from the top right, targeting a single bottle lying on its side. Depth noise speckles the bottles' curved surfaces, and the box's flaps and the conveyor rails are blocky and low-detail at the edges. The image has the flat, textureless quality of a structured-light 3D sensor with no color information.

Egocentric frame from a robotic arm's fixed-focus camera in an electronics assembly cell, looking down at a two-prong insertion tool pressing a single electrolytic capacitor into a PCB through-hole. The capacitor's cylindrical body and the board's green solder mask are in crisp macro focus, and the tool's steel tips bracket the component. The image is clinical and evenly lit by a ring light, with slight chromatic aberration at the corners typical of a cheap industrial lens. A fiducial alignment marker on the PCB is visible near the edge.

Low-light egocentric capture from a night-shift warehouse robot's arm camera, looking at its electromagnetic gripper engaging a single steel shelf bracket from a parts bin. The image is underexposed with visible ISO noise grain, and the bracket's zinc plating reflects the camera's own infrared illuminator as a bright hot spot. The arm's dark housing blends into the shadows at the frame edge, and the bin's other brackets are murky shapes below. A green LED status indicator on the arm's wrist joint glows in the upper corner.

Egocentric view from a paint-line robot's nozzle-adjacent camera, looking along the spray fan as it hits a single metal cabinet panel on a conveyor hook. The atomized white paint creates a soft fog across the center of the frame, partially obscuring the panel's surface. The overspray drifts left, and the booth's exhaust filters and water curtain are dim shapes behind the haze. The image has the yellowish cast of a camera behind a protective film that has accumulated fine paint mist.

Egocentric frame from a food-packing robot's downward camera, looking at its vacuum pad lifting a single sealed plastic tray of sliced deli meat from a conveyor. The tray's clear film lid and the printed weight label are in focus beneath the circular suction pad, which enters the frame from above. The stainless conveyor's mesh belt texture and water droplets from a sanitizing rinse are visible around the tray. The lighting is harsh and even, and the image has slight barrel distortion from the wide-angle lens.

Egocentric capture from a CNC machine-tending robot's wrist camera, looking at its three-jaw chuck gripper clamping a single raw aluminium cylinder inside the open door of a CNC lathe. The cylinder's machined surface catches the lathe's internal work light, and the chuck jaws are visible gripping the stock at three equidistant points. Metal shavings coat the lathe bed below, and the machine's tool turret and coolant nozzle are in the background. The image is slightly blue-tinted from the LED work light.

Egocentric still from a logistics robot's stereo-camera pair, showing a slight parallax offset between the two overlapping views of a single shipping tube on a sorting belt. The arm's rubber-padded V-groove cradle descends toward the tube from the top of the frame. The dual-image has the characteristic side-by-side format of a raw stereo capture, and the belt's black surface and printed routing labels are duplicated in each half. The warehouse's ceiling-mounted cable trays are out of focus above.

Egocentric view from an agricultural harvesting arm's camera, looking through plastic greenhouse sheeting at a single red bell pepper on the vine. The arm's pneumatic cutting blade enters the frame from the left, positioned at the pepper's stem. The greenhouse film creates a diffuse, overexposed background, and the camera's auto-white-balance struggles with the mixed daylight and supplemental grow-light spectrum, giving the foliage an unnatural magenta tint. Water droplets from overhead irrigation bead on the pepper's skin.

Grainy egocentric frame from a depalletizing robot's laser-profiler camera, looking at the top layer of a shrink-wrapped pallet. The arm's fork-style gripper enters from the upper frame, prongs sliding under a single carton at the pallet's corner. A red laser line scans across the carton's surface, mapping its edges, and the shrink wrap reflects the laser in a bright streak. The image is high-contrast and monochrome, with the sensor's limited dynamic range clipping the highlights on the plastic wrap.

Egocentric view from a textile-handling robot's downward camera in a garment distribution center, looking at its needle-array gripper descending toward a single folded t-shirt on a conveyor. The shirt's cotton weave and screen-printed graphic are in flat, even focus typical of telecentric machine-vision optics. The gripper's rows of thin steel needles are visible at the top of the frame, angled to penetrate the fabric. The belt's grey surface and a wrinkled packing slip are at the edges, and the image has zero bokeh, every plane equally sharp.

Egocentric capture from a robotic arm's wrist-mounted camera in a tire warehouse, looking at its expanding mandrel tool inserted into the center bore of a single black rubber tire standing upright on a conveyor. The mandrel's steel fingers splay outward against the tire's inner bead, and the arm's grey forearm and cable bundle are visible at the top of the frame. The tire's sidewall markings and tread pattern are in focus, and the warehouse's high bay is a dark void above, broken only by distant strip lights and the orange glow of another arm operating two aisles over.
